question: Should Crabbox adopt this Wasmtime-fuel subprocess design as the approved first implementation plan for deterministic performance evidence tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/280?
rationale: The documentation intentionally leaves helper distribution, measurement granularity, future CLI surface, cross-host proof, and Wasmtime-upgrade policy for approval; choosing among those options establishes the future product and compatibility boundary rather than correcting an existing defect.

options.title: Approve the proposed v1 design
options.body: Merge the document as the implementation reference, with its stated unresolved details retained for the next implementation PR.

options.title: Keep only the high-level contract
options.body: Retain the merged feature contract and defer this detailed design until maintainers choose the runtime and measurement boundary.

options.title: Request a narrower design revision
options.body: Ask for a short RFC focused on the evidence schema and acceptance criteria before documenting a specific Wasmtime helper architecture.

recommendation.title: Approve the proposed v1 design
recommendation.body: Merge the document as the implementation reference, with its stated unresolved details retained for the next implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged current contract that this PR expands and are the strongest documented owner signal for its intended boundary.
